newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Necochea grain port closed-ship agency.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Necochea grain port closed-ship agency.

text.p: The southern Argentine grain port of Necochea is closed due to bad weather and an excessive swell, the NABSA shipping agency said Thursday.
The port has also imposed special determining drafts until a dredger is able to deepen channels, NABSA said.
Vessels up to 170 tonnes loaded weight have an 11.6-meter determining draft, 190-tonne vessels have an 11.1-meter limit, and 210 tonners have a 9.1-meter limit, NABSA said.
A dredger is under repair and will probably not be able to resume operations until Saturday or Sunday, NABSA said.
